objectives: Explain how the clean and unclean beasts were known before Moses.
Describe what the great deep and the windows of heaven are.
Explain why the flood came, and the twofold meaning of the breath of life.
takeaways: The Most High had defined clean and unclean beasts back in Genesis; the laws teach us to discern between them (Leviticus 11:46-47).
It had never rained on the earth before the flood; a mist watered the ground (Genesis 2:5-6).
The great deep is the seas and rivers; the windows of heaven are the rain.
The flood came upon them that despised the commandments; destruction came because of sin (2 Esdras 3:8-11).
The breath of life is twofold: the commandments given to Adam, and the breath of the body.
